content: 16:Install the dependancies with `pip install -e .[dev]`, then run the tests.

The `Makefile` has two test targets:

```bash
pip install -e .[dev]   # one-time: installs the project plus pytest (per README)

make test-fast          # pytest -m "not postgres" -q  — skips Postgres-marked tests
make test               # pytest -q                    — runs the full suite
```

You can also call pytest directly, for example `pytest tests/ -q`, or pass `-k <name>` to run a subset.

A project memory says to use `make test-fast` by default, and that matches the Makefile. No tests in `tests/` have the `postgres` marker yet, so right now both targets run the same tests. That will change once Postgres-dependent tests are added. I didn't run the suite myself.
